title: Maximum Width of Binary Tree
statement: Return the maximum width of a binary tree, where width at a level includes the gaps between its leftmost and rightmost non-null nodes.

title: Maximum Width of Binary Tree
statement: Return the maximum width of a binary tree, where width at a level includes the gaps between its leftmost and rightmost non-null nodes.
code:
import java.util.*;
class Solution { public int widthOfBinaryTree(TreeNode root){if(root==null)return 0;List<TreeNode> nodes=new ArrayList<>();List<Long> idx=new ArrayList<>();nodes.add(root);idx.add(0L);long best=0;while(!nodes.isEmpty()){long base=idx.get(0);best=Math.max(best,idx.get(idx.size()-1)-base+1);List<TreeNode> nn=new ArrayList<>();List<Long> ni=new ArrayList<>();for(int j=0;j<nodes.size();j++){TreeNode n=nodes.get(j);long i=idx.get(j)-base;if(n.left!=null){nn.add(n.left);ni.add(2*i);}if(n.right!=null){nn.add(n.right);ni.add(2*i+1);}}nodes=nn;idx=ni;}return (int)best;} }

title: Non-decreasing Array
statement: Return true if an array can become non-decreasing by modifying at most one element.
code: class Solution { public boolean checkPossibility(int[] nums){int changed=0;for(int i=1;i<nums.length;i++)if(nums[i]<nums[i-1]){if(++changed>1)return false;if(i<2||nums[i]>=nums[i-2])nums[i-1]=nums[i];else nums[i]=nums[i-1];}return true;} }

title: Beautiful Arrangement II
statement: Construct a permutation of 1..n with exactly k distinct absolute differences between adjacent values.

title: Beautiful Arrangement II
statement: Construct a permutation of 1..n with exactly k distinct absolute differences between adjacent values.
code: class Solution { public int[] constructArray(int n,int k){int[] a=new int[n];int lo=1,hi=k+1,i=0;while(lo<=hi){a[i++]=lo++;if(lo<=hi)a[i++]=hi--;}for(int x=k+2;x<=n;x++)a[i++]=x;return a;} }

title: Trim a Binary Search Tree
statement: Trim a BST so every node value lies in [low, high], preserving BST order.

title: Trim a Binary Search Tree
statement: Trim a BST so every node value lies in [low, high], preserving BST order.
code: class Solution { public TreeNode trimBST(TreeNode root,int low,int high){if(root==null)return null;if(root.val<low)return trimBST(root.right,low,high);if(root.val>high)return trimBST(root.left,low,high);root.left=trimBST(root.left,low,high);root.right=trimBST(root.right,low,high);return root;} }

title: Second Minimum Node In a Binary Tree
statement: In a special binary tree where each node has zero or two children and each parent equals the smaller child value, return the second minimum distinct value, or -1 if absent.
approach_name: Find smallest value greater than root

title: Second Minimum Node In a Binary Tree
statement: In a special binary tree where each node has zero or two children and each parent equals the smaller child value, return the second minimum distinct value, or -1 if absent.
approach_name: Find smallest value greater than root
code: class Solution { public int findSecondMinimumValue(TreeNode root){if(root==null)return -1;long[] best={Long.MAX_VALUE};int first=root.val;dfs(root,first,best);return best[0]==Long.MAX_VALUE?-1:(int)best[0];}private void dfs(TreeNode n,int first,long[] best){if(n==null)return;if(n.val>first){best[0]=Math.min(best[0],n.val);return;}dfs(n.left,first,best);dfs(n.right,first,best);} }

title: Longest Continuous Increasing Subsequence
statement: Return the length of the longest contiguous strictly increasing subsequence.

title: Longest Continuous Increasing Subsequence
statement: Return the length of the longest contiguous strictly increasing subsequence.
code: class Solution { public int findLengthOfLCIS(int[] nums){if(nums.length==0)return 0;int best=1,cur=1;for(int i=1;i<nums.length;i++){cur=nums[i]>nums[i-1]?cur+1:1;best=Math.max(best,cur);}return best;} }

title: Valid Palindrome II
statement: Return true if a string can become a palindrome after deleting at most one character.

title: Valid Palindrome II
statement: Return true if a string can become a palindrome after deleting at most one character.
code: class Solution { public boolean validPalindrome(String s){int l=0,r=s.length()-1;while(l<r){if(s.charAt(l)!=s.charAt(r))return pal(s,l+1,r)||pal(s,l,r-1);l++;r--;}return true;}private boolean pal(String s,int l,int r){while(l<r)if(s.charAt(l++)!=s.charAt(r--))return false;return true;} }

title: Baseball Game
statement: Evaluate baseball scoring operations: integer score, C cancels the last score, D doubles it, and + sums the previous two.

title: Baseball Game
statement: Evaluate baseball scoring operations: integer score, C cancels the last score, D doubles it, and + sums the previous two.
code:
import java.util.*;
class Solution { public int calPoints(String[] operations){List<Integer>s=new ArrayList<>();for(String op:operations){switch(op){case "C":s.remove(s.size()-1);break;case "D":s.add(2*s.get(s.size()-1));break;case "+":s.add(s.get(s.size()-1)+s.get(s.size()-2));break;default:s.add(Integer.parseInt(op));}}int sum=0;for(int x:s)sum+=x;return sum;} }

title: Redundant Connection
statement: In an undirected graph that began as a tree with one extra edge, return the edge that creates a cycle.

title: Redundant Connection
statement: In an undirected graph that began as a tree with one extra edge, return the edge that creates a cycle.
code: class Solution { public int[] findRedundantConnection(int[][] edges){int n=edges.length+1;int[] p=new int[n],rank=new int[n];for(int i=0;i<n;i++)p[i]=i;for(int[]e:edges){int a=find(p,e[0]),b=find(p,e[1]);if(a==b)return e;if(rank[a]<rank[b]){int t=a;a=b;b=t;}p[b]=a;if(rank[a]==rank[b])rank[a]++;}return new int[0];}private int find(int[]p,int x){if(p[x]!=x)p[x]=find(p,p[x]);return p[x];} }

title: Longest Univalue Path
statement: Return the number of edges in the longest path where every node has the same value.

title: Longest Univalue Path
statement: Return the number of edges in the longest path where every node has the same value.
code: class Solution { int best; public int longestUnivaluePath(TreeNode root){best=0;dfs(root);return best;}private int dfs(TreeNode n){if(n==null)return 0;int l=dfs(n.left),r=dfs(n.right),a=0,b=0;if(n.left!=null&&n.left.val==n.val)a=l+1;if(n.right!=null&&n.right.val==n.val)b=r+1;best=Math.max(best,a+b);return Math.max(a,b);} }
